Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles for all compounds in document CHEMBL1150404. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and LEFT JOIN compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1150404'. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
